question: Do the explicit v8 aspectual variables remain operationally reusable when source and target differ in reporter and period, or did the matched construction/family screens rely on shared lexical content?

novelty_search.result: Completed construction and A1/A2 interchange screens held reporter, period, and direction fixed. No explicit-variable screen has deranged the lexical identities.

frozen_design.source_permutation: Within each panel and family, source group_number = (target group_number + 6) mod 16. Offset six is a fixed derangement that preserves direction parity while changing reporter and period for every row.
frozen_design.swap_semantics: The target base-resid18, requested answer/foil, native denominator, global weights, and recurrence stay fixed. source_full supplies every explicit variable from the deranged row; each swap arm replaces exactly one variable group.

predictions.pred_a_authority_derangement_capability_: Hashes, exact fixed derangement, changed reporter/period, preserved direction, native capability, and reconstruction controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_target_program_effect: target_full is positive with at least 0.75 direction in all panels.
predictions.pred_c_whole_lexicon_transfer: source_full retains at least 0.50 of target_full recovery and 0.75 direction in every panel.
predictions.pred_d_groupwise_lexicon_invariance: Each single-group swap retains at least 0.75 of target_full recovery and 0.75 direction in every panel.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage_and_price: All 320 records are unique within 72 counted forwards, 576 example evaluations, and zero fit/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: the three explicit variable groups define a lexicon-invariant operational quotient on the tested corpus.
terminal.null: Authority, target effect, and coverage pass but whole-source or a named group remains lexically bound.
terminal.invalid: Authority, derangement, capability, reconstruction, target effect, or coverage fails.
